summary: SPHINCS+ variant with 16-byte hashes and P = 0. A 184-bit message digest (the signer grinds ρ until its last 10 bits are zero) yields 14 FORS+C leaf indices and a 34-bit hypertree index. The 14 FORS roots form the FORS key; seven layers of WOTS target-sum signatures (42 chains, digit sum 170) and Merkle paths (heights 5,5,5,5,5,5,4) authenticate it to the 16-byte public root. Honest verification costs a constant 18,357 cycles.

facts.label: Message digest split
facts.value: 184 bits of H(tw ‖ P ‖ ρ ‖ 0¹²⁸ ‖ m): bits 0–33 idx, 34–173 u₀…u₁₃ (10 bits each), 174–183 must be 0

facts.label: FORS+C
facts.value: 14 trees of height 10 (15th index group pinned to 0); per tree 16 B secret + 10 × 16 B siblings = 176 B

facts.label: Hypertree
facts.value: 7 layers, heights 5,5,5,5,5,5,4 = 34-bit index; layer 6 (bottom) signs the FORS key, layer 0 root = pk

facts.label: WOTS encoding
facts.value: Target sum, w = 3: H(tw ‖ P ‖ M ‖ LE32 c) → 42 digits of 3 bits summing to 170; c < 2²⁰, no checksum

facts.label: Public key
facts.value: 16 B hypertree root; public parameter P = 0 (no seed); secret key = 32-byte master seed

facts.label: Witness expansion
facts.value: Fixed byte permutation, W = 7,756 B: the 7 counters move to bytes 7,728–7,755 so all 16-byte items are 8-aligned

facts.label: Verification cost
facts.value: 18,357 cycles on every accepting run + ⌈7,756 / 256⌉ = 31 → C = 18,388; 1,072 HASH calls, 1,146 blocks

profile.method: 16 random keys and 32-byte messages (seeded PRNG): ref.py keygen+sign, expand on the emulator, verify traced on vm.py; all 16 accepted at 18,357 cycles each
